name: mmm-chaostheory
description: MagicMirror² module: chaos theory in motion, physically correct and cheap enough for a Raspberry Pi: the Lorenz attractor, diverging double pendulums, fractal basins, the logistic map, symmetric icons, the three-body problem, chaotic billiards, rule 30, the standard map, the chaotic waterwheel and the sandpile, each with its equations and live numbers.
author: Charles West
